reference_sql:
WITH november_signups AS (
  -- one row per sign_up event of 1 to 30 November 2025 (Dublin days): only the column the count needs
  SELECT geo.country AS country
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
)
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS signups
FROM november_signups
GROUP BY country

WITH november_signups AS (
  -- one row per sign_up event of 1 to 30 November 2025 (Dublin days): only the column the count needs
  SELECT geo.country AS country
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up'
    AND CAST(strptime(event_date, '%Y%m%d') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-11-30'
)
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS signups
FROM november_signups
GROUP BY country
